title: INDoS WG3 Training School 2026: reproducible environments and critical reading materials
description:
Teaching materials on how to read and review a neuroimaging paper and on the Federated Journal Club, prepared for the Training School of Working Group 3 of the INDoS COST Action (CA24161), Madrid, 30 September to 2 October 2026.

The slides are served at www.indos-costaction.eu/wg3-ts2026-garcia. They run on remark-engine, included in the repository as a git submodule and therefore not part of this archive: clone the repository with git clone --recurse-submodules to run them locally.

creators.name: Garcia, Mélanie
creators.affiliation: Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School, Boston, USA

notes: This publication is based upon work from COST Action CA24161 (INDoS), supported by COST (European Cooperation in Science and Technology).
